title: Image output gets its full 4K option back
summary:
A compact compatibility pass: 4K images, sturdier multi-provider chat calls, clearer errors, and quieter balance checks.

nanobanana-pro can now serve 4K generation requests correctly, restoring high-resolution output for projects that need more than thumbnail-sized pixels.

The OpenAI-compatible schema is more forgiving across providers, while Azure requests now handle max_tokens correctly and surface upstream error statuses instead of disguising them.

Local balance tracking reduces repeated Polar API calls and the rate-limit friction that comes with asking the same question too often.
